169: def same_directory_identity(actual, expected):
170:     """Retained directory identity; its observed byte length may change.
171: 
172:     The native identity query still rejects reparse points and pending deletion.
173:     Keep FileIdentity equality intact for regular files and recorded evidence.
174:     """
175:     return (type(actual) is FileIdentity and type(expected) is FileIdentity
176:             and actual.directory is True and expected.directory is True
177:             and type(actual.size) is int and 0 <= actual.size < 1 << 63
178:             and type(expected.size) is int and 0 <= expected.size < 1 << 63
179:             and actual.final_path == expected.final_path
180:             and actual.volume_serial == expected.volume_serial
181:             and actual.file_id == expected.file_id and actual.links == expected.links)

221: def _absolute_local_path(path):
222:     # Lexical restriction only. No resolve/stat/query happens in this helper.
223:     if type(path) is str and path.casefold() == FORBIDDEN_LIVE.casefold():
224:         raise KernelUnavailable("Fixed live-index path is prohibited")
225:     if (type(path) is not str or not 3 <= len(path) <= 4096 or path[1:3] != ":\\"
226:             or path[0] not in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
227:             or any(ch in path for ch in ('\x00', '/', '"', '*', '?')) or ':' in path[2:]
228:             or any(ord(ch) < 32 for ch in path)):
229:         raise KernelUnavailable("Fixed local DOS path required")
230:     if len(path) == 3:
231:         return path
232:     parts = path[3:].split("\\")
233:     if any(not part or part in (".", "..") or part.endswith((" ", ".")) for part in parts):
234:         raise KernelUnavailable("Ambiguous path component refused")
235:     reserved = {"CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", "CONIN$", "CONOUT$"} | {
236:         prefix + suffix for prefix in ("COM", "LPT") for suffix in "123456789¹²³"}
237:     if any(part.split(".", 1)[0].upper() in reserved for part in parts):
238:         raise KernelUnavailable("DOS device component refused")
239:     return path

242: def _quote_argument(value):
243:     # Windows CRT command line quoting, without invoking a shell.
244:     if type(value) is not str or '\x00' in value or len(value) > 4096:
245:         raise KernelUnavailable("Worker argument refused")
246:     result, slashes = '"', 0
247:     for char in value:
248:         if char == "\\":
249:             slashes += 1
250:         elif char == '"':
251:             result += "\\" * (slashes * 2 + 1) + '"'
252:             slashes = 0
253:         else:
254:             result += "\\" * slashes + char
255:             slashes = 0
256:     return result + "\\" * (slashes * 2) + '"'

259: def _environment_block(pairs):
260:     # An explicit bootstrap allowlist, never inherited os.environ or credentials.
261:     required = {"TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD": "0", "HF_HUB_OFFLINE": "1", "TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE": "1",
262:                 "PYANNOTE_METRICS_ENABLED": "0",
263:                 "IG_FORBIDDEN_LIVE": FORBIDDEN_LIVE}
264:     allowed = set(required) | {"SystemRoot", "WINDIR", "TEMP", "TMP"}
265:     if type(pairs) is not dict or set(pairs) != allowed or any(pairs.get(k) != v for k, v in required.items()):
266:         raise KernelUnavailable("Exact scrubbed worker environment required")
267:     for name in allowed - set(required):
268:         _absolute_local_path(pairs[name])
269:     block = "\x00".join(name + "=" + pairs[name] for name in sorted(pairs, key=str.upper)) + "\x00\x00"
270:     if len(block) > 32767:
271:         raise KernelUnavailable("Worker environment size refused")
272:     return block

275: class OwnedWin32Primitives:
276:     """Concrete handle/process mechanics; no complete acquire_read capability.
277: 
278:     A trusted single-threaded bootstrap owns this object. HandleRecord and
279:     WorkerRecord instances are also tracked by identity; external lookalikes
280:     do not authorize operations. Recovery after process death is not supplied.
281:     """
282: 
283:     def __init__(self, api):
284:         self.api = api
285:         self.handles = []
286:         self.workers = []
287:         self.read_sets = []
288: 
289:     def _retain(self, value, kind):
290:         invalid = self.api.ffi.c_void_p(-1).value
291:         if value is None or value == 0 or value == invalid:
292:             raise OSError(self.api.ffi.get_last_error(), kind + " returned an invalid handle")
293:         record = HandleRecord(value, kind)
294:         self.handles.append(record)
295:         return record
296: 
297:     def _owned(self, handle):
298:         if not any(item is handle for item in self.handles) or handle.closed or handle.unconfirmed:
299:             raise KernelUnconfirmed("Handle ownership is not confirmed")
300:         return handle.value
301: 
302:     def _close(self, handle):
303:         value = self._owned(handle)
304:         try:
305:             self.api.checked("CloseHandle", value)
306:         except BaseException:
307:             handle.unconfirmed = True
308:             raise
309:         handle.closed = True
310: 
311:     def _query(self, handle, kind, class_id):
312:         data = self.api.structure(kind)
313:         self.api.checked("GetFileInformationByHandleEx", self._owned(handle), class_id,
314:                          self.api.ffi.byref(data), self.api.ffi.sizeof(data))
315:         return data
316: 
317:     def identity(self, handle):
318:         ffi = self.api.ffi
319:         tags = self._query(handle, "FILE_ATTRIBUTE_TAG_INFO", FILE_ATTRIBUTE_TAG_INFO_CLASS)
320:         standard = self._query(handle, "FILE_STANDARD_INFO", FILE_STANDARD_INFO_CLASS)
321:         identity = self._query(handle, "FILE_ID_INFO", FILE_ID_INFO_CLASS)
322:         if tags.attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT or tags.reparse_tag or standard.delete_pending or standard.size < 0:
323:             raise KernelUnavailable("Reparse, pending deletion or invalid size refused")
324:         buffer = ffi.create_unicode_buffer(32768)
325:         length = self.api.call("GetFinalPathNameByHandleW", self._owned(handle), buffer, len(buffer), 0)
326:         if not 0 < length < len(buffer):
327:             raise KernelUnavailable("Final handle path is unavailable or oversized")
328:         return FileIdentity(buffer.value, int(identity.volume), bytes(identity.file_id), int(standard.size),
329:                             int(standard.links), bool(standard.directory))

331:     def pin_exact_members(self, expectations):
332:         """Open an explicit read set; NOT namespace protection or model approval.
333: 
334:         expectations are trusted proposed bootstrap inputs. This checks known
335:         identities, but cannot establish a loader's unknown future name set.
336:         """
337:         if type(expectations) is not tuple or not 1 <= len(expectations) <= 128:
338:             raise KernelUnavailable("Bounded exact read set required")
339:         read_set = ReadSet()
340:         self.read_sets.append(read_set)  # Retain partial acquisition immediately.
341:         try:
342:             seen = set()
343:             for path, expected in expectations:
344:                 _absolute_local_path(path)
345:                 if path.casefold() in seen or type(expected) is not FileIdentity:
346:                     raise KernelUnavailable("Read-set input identity refused")
347:                 seen.add(path.casefold())
348:                 access = FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES if expected.directory else GENERIC_READ
349:                 flags = FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT | (FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS if expected.directory else 0)
350:                 value = self.api.call("CreateFileW", path, access, FILE_SHARE_READ, None, OPEN_EXISTING, flags, None)
351:                 handle = self._retain(value, "read-member")
352:                 read_set.members.append(handle)
353:                 actual = self.identity(handle)
354:                 matched = (same_directory_identity(actual, expected) if expected.directory
355:                            else actual == expected)
356:                 if not matched or (not actual.directory and actual.links != 1):
357:                     raise KernelUnavailable("Opened identity differs from the exact approved member")
358:                 read_set.identities.append(actual)
359:             return read_set
360:         except BaseException:
361:             # Deliberately retain partial acquisition. Recovery/release requires
362:             # a separate owner decision; no destructor silently closes handles.
363:             read_set.unconfirmed = True
364:             raise

366:     def _duplicate_inheritable(self, handle):
367:         ffi = self.api.ffi
368:         duplicate = ffi.c_void_p()
369:         current = self.api.call("GetCurrentProcess")
370:         self.api.checked("DuplicateHandle", current, self._owned(handle), current,
371:                          ffi.byref(duplicate), 0, 1, DUPLICATE_SAME_ACCESS)
372:         return self._retain(duplicate.value, "inheritable-read-member")
373: 
374:     def _creation_time(self, process):
375:         values = [self.api.structure("FILETIME") for _ in range(4)]
376:         self.api.checked("GetProcessTimes", self._owned(process), *(self.api.ffi.byref(item) for item in values))
377:         return int(values[0].low) | int(values[0].high) << 32

379:     def _adopt_process_outputs(self, worker):
380:         # The mutable API output structure is retained before CreateProcessW.
381:         # On a Python interruption, preserve any returned handles for cleanup.
382:         if worker.creation_info is not None:
383:             for field_name in ("process", "thread"):
384:                 value = getattr(worker.creation_info, field_name)
385:                 if value and getattr(worker, field_name) is None:
386:                     setattr(worker, field_name, self._retain(value, field_name))

388:     def create_suspended_worker(self, read_set, executable, arguments, working_directory, environment,
389:                                 inherited_control_handles=(), include_control_handle_argument=False):
390:         """Owned suspended process only; no runtime command/resume admission.
391: 
392:         No shell, process-name lookup, ambient environment or breakaway flags.
393:         Inherited guards protect their corresponding files through child death
394:         only if a future trusted bootstrap keeps them open. That is unqualified.
395:         """
396:         if (not any(item is read_set for item in self.read_sets) or read_set.unconfirmed
397:                 or read_set.released or read_set.worker_reserved
398:                 or len(read_set.members) != len(read_set.identities)):
399:             raise KernelUnconfirmed("Read-set ownership refused")
400:         if type(inherited_control_handles) is not tuple or len(inherited_control_handles) not in (0, 1):
401:             raise KernelUnavailable("One exact inherited duplex control endpoint required")
402:         for handle in inherited_control_handles:
403:             if handle.kind != "ipc-client":
404:                 raise KernelUnavailable("Wrong inherited control handle kind")
405:             self._owned(handle)
406:         if type(include_control_handle_argument) is not bool or (include_control_handle_argument and len(inherited_control_handles) != 1):
407:             raise KernelUnavailable("Fixed control argument requires one inherited endpoint")
408:         _absolute_local_path(executable)
409:         _absolute_local_path(working_directory)
410:         if type(arguments) is not tuple or not 1 <= len(arguments) <= 16:
411:             raise KernelUnavailable("Fixed worker arguments required")
412:         command = " ".join(_quote_argument(value) for value in (executable,) + arguments)
413:         if len(command) > 32766:
414:             raise KernelUnavailable("Worker command size refused")
415:         environment_text = _environment_block(environment)
416:         worker = WorkerRecord(read_set=read_set)
417:         self.workers.append(worker)  # Retain ownership before any allocation.
418:         read_set.worker_reserved = True
419:         ffi = self.api.ffi
420:         attributes = None
421:         initialized = False
422:         pending_error = None
423:         try:
424:             worker.job = self._retain(self.api.call("CreateJobObjectW", None, None), "job")
425:             limits = self.api.structure("JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION")
426:             limits.basic.flags = JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE | JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_ACTIVE_PROCESS
427:             limits.basic.active_process_limit = 1
428:             self.api.checked("SetInformationJobObject", self._owned(worker.job), JOB_EXTENDED_LIMIT_CLASS,
429:                              ffi.byref(limits), ffi.sizeof(limits))
430:             for handle in (*read_set.members, *inherited_control_handles):
431:                 worker.inherited_copies.append(self._duplicate_inheritable(handle))
432:             worker.child_read_handles = tuple(self._owned(handle) for handle in worker.inherited_copies[:len(read_set.members)])
433:             if inherited_control_handles:
434:                 worker.child_control_handle = self._owned(worker.inherited_copies[-1])
435:             if include_control_handle_argument:
436:                 # These decimal values identify inherited handles in this exact
437:                 # child. They are not credentials or serialized capabilities.
438:                 command = " ".join(_quote_argument(value) for value in (executable,) + arguments
439:                                    + ("--control-handle", str(worker.child_control_handle)))
440:                 if len(command) > 32766:
441:                     raise KernelUnavailable("Worker command size refused")
442:             size = ffi.c_size_t()
443:             first = self.api.call("InitializeProcThreadAttributeList", None, 1, 0, ffi.byref(size))
444:             error = ffi.get_last_error()
445:             if first or error != ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER or not 0 < size.value <= 65536:
446:                 raise KernelUnavailable("Attribute-list size query refused")
447:             attributes = ffi.create_string_buffer(size.value)
448:             self.api.checked("InitializeProcThreadAttributeList", attributes, 1, 0, ffi.byref(size))
449:             initialized = True
450:             inherited = (ffi.c_void_p * len(worker.inherited_copies))(*(self._owned(h) for h in worker.inherited_copies))
451:             self.api.checked("UpdateProcThreadAttribute", attributes, 0, PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST,
452:                              inherited, ffi.sizeof(inherited), None, None)
453:             startup = self.api.structure("STARTUPINFOEXW")
454:             startup.startup.cb = ffi.sizeof(startup)
455:             startup.startup.flags = STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
456:             startup.startup.show = SW_HIDE
457:             startup.attributes = ffi.cast(attributes, ffi.c_void_p)
458:             process = self.api.structure("PROCESS_INFORMATION")
459:             worker.creation_info = process
460:             command_buffer = ffi.create_unicode_buffer(command)
461:             environment_buffer = ffi.create_unicode_buffer(environment_text)
462:             self.api.checked("CreateProcessW", executable, command_buffer, None, None, 1,
463:                              CREATE_SUSPENDED | CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT | EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT,
464:                              environment_buffer, working_directory, ffi.byref(startup), ffi.byref(process))
465:             self._adopt_process_outputs(worker)
466:             if worker.process is None or worker.thread is None:
467:                 raise KernelUnconfirmed("CreateProcessW returned incomplete owned handles")
468:             self.api.checked("AssignProcessToJobObject", self._owned(worker.job), self._owned(worker.process))
469:             worker.assigned = True
470:             worker.creation_time = self._creation_time(worker.process)
471:             # Child has its own inherited handles. Keep the originals in the
472:             # read set, but remove temporary inheritable parent duplicates.
473:             for handle in worker.inherited_copies:
474:                 self._close(handle)
475:             return worker
476:         except BaseException as original:
477:             pending_error = original
478:             worker.unconfirmed = True
479:             read_set.unconfirmed = True
480:             try:
481:                 self._adopt_process_outputs(worker)
482:                 self._stop_partial_worker(worker, 5000)
483:             except BaseException as cleanup_error:
484:                 original.add_note("Partial worker remains owned/unconfirmed: " + type(cleanup_error).__name__)
485:             raise
486:         finally:
487:             if initialized:
488:                 # Deletes only the local attribute list; not owned process/file
489:                 # handles. The call is void and has no success receipt itself.
490:                 try:
491:                     self.api.call("DeleteProcThreadAttributeList", attributes)
492:                 except BaseException as cleanup_error:
493:                     worker.unconfirmed = True
494:                     read_set.unconfirmed = True
495:                     if pending_error is None:
496:                         try:
497:                             self._adopt_process_outputs(worker)
498:                             self._stop_partial_worker(worker, 5000)
499:                         except BaseException as stop_error:
500:                             cleanup_error.add_note("Worker stop remains unconfirmed: " + type(stop_error).__name__)
501:                         raise
502:                     pending_error.add_note("Attribute-list cleanup raised: " + type(cleanup_error).__name__)

504:     def _stop_partial_worker(self, worker, timeout_ms):
505:         if worker.process is None:
506:             return False
507:         process = self._owned(worker.process)
508:         if worker.assigned:
509:             self.api.checked("TerminateJobObject", self._owned(worker.job), 1)
510:         else:
511:             # A child created suspended but not assigned cannot be released.
512:             # Terminate the exact retained process handle, never an integer PID.
513:             self.api.checked("TerminateProcess", process, 1)
514:         return self.api.call("WaitForSingleObject", process, timeout_ms) == WAIT_OBJECT_0

516:     def resume_worker(self, worker):
517:         # Mechanics are present below for review, but complete worker bootstrap,
518:         # IPC, namespace and loader admission is not represented by this record.
519:         raise KernelUnavailable("No real worker bootstrap/load-plan admission exists")

521:     def _resume_after_future_admission(self, worker):
522:         if (not any(item is worker for item in self.workers) or worker.unconfirmed or not worker.assigned
523:                 or worker.resumed or worker.shutdown_started or worker.creation_time != self._creation_time(worker.process)):
524:             raise KernelUnconfirmed("Suspended worker identity/state refused")
525:         try:
526:             prior = self.api.call("ResumeThread", self._owned(worker.thread))
527:             if prior != 1:
528:                 raise KernelUnconfirmed("Suspended thread count was not exactly one")
529:             worker.resumed = True
530:         except BaseException:
531:             worker.unconfirmed = True
532:             worker.read_set.unconfirmed = True
533:             raise

535:     def terminate_and_observe(self, worker, timeout_ms=5000):
536:         if (not any(item is worker for item in self.workers) or worker.unconfirmed or not worker.assigned
537:                 or type(timeout_ms) is not int or not 0 <= timeout_ms <= 30000):
538:             raise KernelUnconfirmed("Worker termination scope refused")
539:         if worker.quiescent:
540:             return True
541:         worker.shutdown_started = True
542:         try:
543:             if worker.creation_time != self._creation_time(worker.process):
544:                 raise KernelUnconfirmed("Retained process creation identity changed")
545:             self.api.checked("TerminateJobObject", self._owned(worker.job), 1)
546:             waited = self.api.call("WaitForSingleObject", self._owned(worker.process), timeout_ms)
547:             if waited != WAIT_OBJECT_0:
548:                 raise KernelUnconfirmed("Exact process termination was not observed")
549:             accounting = self.api.structure("JOBOBJECT_BASIC_ACCOUNTING_INFORMATION")
550:             returned = self.api.ffi.c_uint32()
551:             self.api.checked("QueryInformationJobObject", self._owned(worker.job), JOB_BASIC_ACCOUNTING_CLASS,
552:                              self.api.ffi.byref(accounting), self.api.ffi.sizeof(accounting), self.api.ffi.byref(returned))
553:             if returned.value != self.api.ffi.sizeof(accounting) or accounting.active_processes != 0:
554:                 raise KernelUnconfirmed("Job still has active or unconfirmed work")
555:             worker.quiescent = True
556:             return True
557:         except BaseException:
558:             worker.unconfirmed = True
559:             worker.read_set.unconfirmed = True
560:             raise
561: 
562:     def close_quiescent_worker_handles(self, worker):
563:         if (not any(item is worker for item in self.workers) or worker.unconfirmed or not worker.quiescent):
564:             raise KernelUnconfirmed("Worker handle closure requires observed quiescence")
565:         try:
566:             for handle in (worker.thread, worker.process, worker.job):
567:                 if handle is not None and not handle.closed:
568:                     self._close(handle)
569:         except BaseException:
570:             worker.unconfirmed = True
571:             worker.read_set.unconfirmed = True
572:             raise

574:     def release_read_set(self, read_set):
575:         if not any(item is read_set for item in self.read_sets) or read_set.unconfirmed or read_set.released:
576:             raise KernelUnconfirmed("Read-set release refused")
577:         owners = [worker for worker in self.workers if worker.read_set is read_set]
578:         if any(worker.unconfirmed or not worker.quiescent for worker in owners):
579:             raise KernelUnconfirmed("Owned native lifetime remains unconfirmed")
580:         try:
581:             for handle in reversed(read_set.members):
582:                 if not handle.closed:
583:                     self._close(handle)
584:             read_set.released = True
585:             return True
586:         except BaseException:
587:             read_set.unconfirmed = True
588:             raise
